youtube.title: Why Paper Towels Have a Pattern Pressed In 🧻 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The pattern pressed into paper towels is called embossing, and it does real work. Most paper towels are two thin plies of paper, and embossing presses them together so they hold as one sheet, often without glue. The raised bumps also leave tiny air pockets between the layers. Those pockets hold water, so the towel absorbs more, and they make the sheet thicker and softer to the touch.
